ops.title: D11 resolved: pre-existing-issue nudge scores prose only (12.76.0, cc-transcript 14.33.0)
ops.body: Follow-up to 88c8a8f. cc-transcript #44 (v14.33.0) adds a required thinking flag to the signal_texts snapshot query. captain-hook #241 (v12.76.0) adds Signals(thinking=False), threads it through transcript_texts on both evidence paths, and sets it on the steering pre-existing-issue nudge. All 7 logged thinking misfires are Allow tests (THINKING_MISFIRES). Accepted loss: a dismissal stated only in thinking (deploy-experience #2664) no longer fires; the prose form still warns.
